guide.summary: City museums, parks, the Russian cathedral and the opera, with socca, dinner tables, hotel bars and confectioners checked against their own websites.
highlights: Parc de la Colline du Château
guide.tip: Plan museum days around closures: the Matisse, Chagall, Masséna, Lascaris and Archaeology museums close on Tuesdays, while the Beaux-Arts, Photography and Natural History museums close on Mondays.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: Musée Matisse, Musée national Marc Chagall, Musée Masséna and Palais Lascaris are closed on Tuesdays. Musée des Beaux-Arts Jules Chéret, the Photography museum and the Muséum d'Histoire naturelle close on Mondays instead.

toolkit.label: Tickets
toolkit.copy: The city's Pass 10 Musées costs 15 € for four days, with single entry at 10 € for Matisse, Masséna and Beaux-Arts and 5 € for Lascaris. Entry to the Musée national Marc Chagall is free for everyone on the first Sunday of the month.

toolkit.label: Walk-in or book
toolkit.copy: Chez Pipo serves without reservation, Wednesday to Sunday. Jan takes bookings only through its website, requires a deposit and asks you to confirm 48 hours ahead.

toolkit.label: Rules
toolkit.copy: Jan's dress code is "Chic / Elegant" and dogs are not allowed. Cathédrale Saint-Nicolas is closed to tourists on Sundays from 9:00 to 12:00.

guide.dek: Group the Cimiez museums on one morning, avoid Tuesdays for most museums, and book Jan well ahead.
intro: Nice's city-run museums publish their hours and current exhibitions on nice.fr, so you can plan around them. Up in Cimiez, the Musée Matisse at 164 avenue des Arènes de Cimiez opens "Henri Matisse – Alex Katz" on 28 October 2026, running to 18 January 2027. The Archaeology museum next door hosts "Mémoires des ruines" by Anne et Patrick Poirier, a MAMAC exhibition with free entry, from 7 November 2026 to 5 September 2027. Both are closed on Tuesdays, and from 1 November they close at 17:00.

Down the hill, the Musée national Marc Chagall on avenue du Docteur Ménard is also closed on Tuesdays. From 1 November 2026 it opens 10:00 to 17:00 with a break from 13:00 to 14:30, though the garden and bookshop stay open during the pause. In the old town, Palais Lascaris on rue Droite has "Merveilles et curiosités du Palais Lascaris" until 11 January 2027. The Photography museum on place Pierre Gautier shows Sabine Weiss until 31 January 2027, and Musée Masséna's "Nice, ma ville, mes jardins" runs until 28 February 2027.

For open air, the Parc de la Colline du Château on Montée Monfort opens daily from 08:30, closing at 18:00 from 1 November. The Promenade du Paillon opens 07:00 to 21:00 in winter, and the Jardin du Monastère de Cimiez keeps the same 08:30 start as the castle hill. Parc Phoenix, on the Promenade des Anglais, opens daily and stops ticket sales an hour before closing. The Cathédrale Saint-Nicolas welcomes visitors daily but is closed to tourists on Sunday mornings until noon.

For food, Chez Pipo on rue Bavastro serves without reservation from Wednesday to Sunday, while Jan on rue Lascaris seats one dinner service five nights a week, with booking and a deposit required. Café de Turin on place Garibaldi serves every day from noon. Hôtel Aston La Scala's L'Horloge serves breakfast from 7:30, and its Aston Club bar opens year-round from 17:00. Les Folies d'Edmonde pours cocktails nightly from 18:00. At the Opéra de Nice, "La Veuve joyeuse" plays 11–13 November.
summaryCards: Pair the Parc de la Colline du Château with Palais Lascaris and the Photography museum in the old town, avoiding Tuesday for Lascaris.
Take breakfast at L'Horloge from 7:30, then head up to Cimiez for the Musée Matisse and the Jardin du Monastère.
Jan needs an online booking with a deposit and confirmation 48 hours ahead, while Chez Pipo takes no reservations.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability. Several sites could not be read: the Hôtel Negresco and Café du Cycliste returned HTTP 429, the Hyatt and Radisson pages returned 403, La Merenda and Flaveur had SSL errors, and Le Safari, Old Sport Club and Hôtel Beau Rivage did not connect. Some confirmed places publish only partial details: Jan gives no exact days or times, Le Patio at Hôtel La Pérouse publishes no hours, and Chez Pipo's footer and map link give different postcodes (06300 and 06000). The Cours Saleya market has no city page that could be found, and MAMAC remains closed for renovation. The guide has no dedicated specialty coffee shop or bread bakery, because none could be confirmed on an official site.
